g.title: j2568275980
g.text: Lyon? I'm very, very sorry if what I said made you uncomfortable. That wasn't my intention.

g.title: j1589420450
g.text: What would you care to discuss, Drifter?

g.title: j3224343848
g.text: I suppose then, I am simply left wondering, if you were not being flirtatious with me in order to make me uncomfortable for your own amusement... why were you being flirtatious in the first place?

g.title: j3661057796
g.text: Your flirtatious commentary for your own amusement? Or would you like to move on to other topics?

g.title: j702246412
g.text: I'm interested in you, Lyon. It's as simple as that.

g.title: j3909137254
g.text: I don't know what got into me, Lyon. Clearly this was all a mistake. I'm very sorry.

g.title: j4131499256
g.text: I... meant what I said. But this is all too fast, I understand.

g.title: j917761598
g.text: I wasn't flirting with you to amuse myself, Lyon. I'm sorry if you think that's what it was about.

g.title: j2437503155
g.text: I didn't mean to offend you, I was just teasing. I'm sorry.

g.title: j3234856851
g.text: And it is not mutual. It is as simple as that.

g.title: j3859659039
g.text: And pardon my bluntness once more when I express all that has come to overwhelm my mind as of late:

g.title: j2734898135
g.text: I am surrounded now by strangers and talking beasts in a world of fantastical madness and seemingly endless and rampant slaughter.

g.title: j2961851108
g.text: All that I have known has been swept away by glowing beams of "Jade Light" and "the Orokin Empire" and "the Void" and is threatened by "the Murmur."

g.title: j123836827
g.text: So, you will have to excuse me if I find this... offer of attraction from you oddly laughable in its naïveté. I neither know you nor trust you. Indeed, all I have to go on is the word of others.

g.title: j3010663279
g.text: The word of others whom I also neither know nor trust as of yet.

g.title: j1075443245
g.text: All this, meanwhile, is only the outward forces that are heaped up before Marie and I - let alone all the rest I contend with that you cannot see.

g.title: j1211881791
g.text: I appreciate your forwardness. I know what you are attempting, and I commend you for it. And I hope, that should the time come that I... rethink your offer? That it still stands.

g.title: j181171597
g.text: In the words of a dear friend, "i'm stubborn, m8."
